DECLARE @q nvarchar(100) = LTRIM(RTRIM('{{ BillSelect.filterText || "" }}'));

SELECT TOP 50
    b.IdBill,
    b.IdClient,
    c.ClientName,
    b.IdClientAccount,
    b.IdVendor,
    CONVERT(varchar(10), b.InvoiceDate, 23) AS InvoiceDate,
    ca.AccountNumber,
    ca.AccountNumber_Raw,
    v.VendorName,
    aa.ArcadiaAccountId,
    aa.ProviderName
FROM dbo.Bill b
INNER JOIN dbo.ClientAccount ca ON ca.IdClientAccount = b.IdClientAccount
LEFT JOIN dbo.Client c ON c.IdClient = b.IdClient
LEFT JOIN dbo.Vendor v ON v.IdVendor = b.IdVendor
LEFT JOIN dbo.ArcadiaAccounts aa
    ON aa.IdClient = b.IdClient
    AND aa.AccountNumber = ca.AccountNumber_Raw
WHERE b.InvoiceDate IS NOT NULL
  AND LEN(@q) >= 2
  AND (
      CAST(b.IdBill AS varchar(20)) LIKE @q + '%'
      OR ca.AccountNumber_Raw LIKE '%' + @q + '%'
      OR ca.AccountNumber LIKE '%' + @q + '%'
  )
ORDER BY b.IdBill DESC;
